name: vitals
description: A light, framed live dashboard above the prompt, in the terminal and in the desktop app: model and effort, context and plan-limit meters, cost and burn rate, tokens and cache per turn and session, auto-compaction, every subagent with its model and effort, background shells, live tools, and weekly and monthly usage from ccusage. Sized to the rows it has, never scrolling. /vitals compact line, /vitals pane full view, /vitals report usage report.

cache_ttl.title: Prompt-cache TTL
cache_ttl.description: How long the main conversation's prompt cache lives: 1h or 5m (anything else counts as 1h). The band marks the cache cold after this much idle time. 1h on a Claude subscription within plan usage; 5m with API billing, a cloud provider or usage credits.
